notes: Survey of 268 pastoralist household heads in three grazing reserves (Dauchi, Gongoshi, Sorau), Adamawa State, 2025. Grazing reserves could fall under rotational_grazing (subtype deferred / seasonal reserves), and the questionnaire lists rotational grazing, cover-crop planting and silvopasture, but these are only rated. All results are Likert-type mean scores of perceived management effectiveness (Table 2, p7: e.g. rotational grazing 1.94, planting of cover crops 2.41, silvopasture 1.92) and mean ratings of financing sources (Table 3, p8). Neither is an adoption rate (share/number adopting), an adoption driver, a cost/return or carbon income; the authors state the results are perceptions, not effects (p8). Borderline: a reviewer could read the mean 'application' scores as an adoption proxy; the scale is not defined in the paper (no anchors given), so they cannot be converted to a rate.
